title: Corpus document / bundle (Rescribe -> Elide -> analysis tool)
description: Shared envelope for the whole chain. Rules: (1) every tool MUST preserve unknown fields and the ext.<tool> namespaces it does not own; (2) ids (document, speaker, segment) are assigned once, at the first export, and never change; (3) only a 'sensitivity: anonymized|public' document may leave Elide towards the analysis tool; (4) the pseudonym key (real name <-> tag) is NEVER part of this format.

id.description: Stable, e.g. d_<base36 time><rand>. Assigned by the first tool that exports it.

kind.description: interview/fieldnote/meeting/other = primary data (codable). reference = literature (context, not coded).

sensitivity.description: raw = contains real identities (Rescribe output). anonymized = Elide output, reviewed. public = published material (articles), never needs Elide.

meta.description: Free but conventional keys. Mirrors Rescribe state.meta.

bib.description: Only for kind=reference. CSL-JSON subset (author, issued, title, container-title, DOI, ...).

label.description: raw doc: real name. anonymized doc: pseudonym tag, e.g. [ENQUETE_1].

id.description: Stable, e.g. seg_0001. Never renumbered, even if segments are merged/split (new id for the new piece).

text.description: Content for the document's sensitivity level. In an anonymized doc this is the anonymized text and the raw text is ABSENT.

textHash.description: sha256 (hex, first 16 chars) of text; lets downstream tools detect that offsets are stale.

entities.description: Only in anonymized docs: tags present in the text, without their real value.

review.description: Human review gate. The analysis tool refuses to send a document to any LLM unless sensitivity=public or review.status=validated.

coverage.description: Share of segments confirmed by a human (0-1)

provenance.description: Append-only chain. Each tool appends one entry when it exports.

ext.description: Tool-private namespaces: ext.rescribe, ext.elide, ext.analysis. Preserve what you don't own.
